                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Principal amount (P) = ₹25,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rate of interest for the first year (R1) = 4% = 0.04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rate of interest for the second year (R2) = 5% = 0.05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rate of interest for the third year (R3) = 6% = 0.06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Amount after nth year = P × (1 + Rn)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Amount after the first year:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 25000 × (1 + 0.04)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 25000 × 1.04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 26000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Amount after the second year:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A2 = 26000 × (1 + 0.05)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A2 = 26000 × 1.05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A2 = 27300

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Amount after the third year:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A3 = 27300 × (1 + 0.06)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A3 = 27300 × 1.06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A3 = 28938

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Interest earned = A3 - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Interest earned = 28938 - 25000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Interest earned = 3938

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The interest on the amount of ₹25,000 compounded annually at the rate of 4%, 5% and 6% per annum for the first, second and third year respectively is ₹3938.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n219:", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                मूलधन (P) = ₹25,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                पहले वर्ष के लिए ब्याज दर (R1) = 4% = 0.04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दूसरे वर्ष के लिए ब्याज दर (R2) = 5% = 0.05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                तीसरे वर्ष के लिए ब्याज दर (R3) = 6% = 0.06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                nth वर्ष के बाद राशि = P × (1 + Rn)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                पहले वर्ष के बाद राशि:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 25000 × (1 + 0.04)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 25000 × 1.04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 26000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दूसरे वर्ष के बाद राशि:ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                అసలు మొత్తం (P) = ₹25,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                మొదటి సంవత్సరం వడ్డీ రేటు (R1) = 4% = 0.04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                రెండవ సంవత్సరం వడ్డీ రేటు (R2) = 5% = 0.05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                మూడవ సంవత్సరం వడ్డీ రేటు (R3) = 6% = 0.06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                nth సంవత్సరం తర్వాత మొత్తం = P x (1 + Rn)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                మొదటి సంవత్సరం తర్వాత మొత్తం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 25000 x (1 + 0.04)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 25000 x 1.04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 26000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                రెండవ సంవత్సరం తర్వాత మొత్తం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A2 = 26000 x (1 + 0.05)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A2 = 26000 x 1.05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                সুতরাং, প্রথম, দ্বিতীয় এবং তৃতীয় বছর যথাক্রমে 4%, 5% এবং 6% বার্ষিক হারে চক্রবৃদ্ধি হারে 25,000 টাকার সুদ হবে 3938 টাকা।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                முதல் ஆண்டின் தொகை:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 25000 x (1 + 0.04)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 25000 x 1\n.04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A1 = 26000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                இரண்டாம் ஆண்டின் தொகை:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A2 = 26000 x (1 + 0.05)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A2 = 26000 x 1.05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A2 = 27300

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                மூன்றாம் ஆண்டின் தொகை:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A3 = 27300 x (1 + 0.06)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A3 = 27300 x 1.06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ A3 = 28938

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                கிடைத்த வட்டி = A3 - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ கிடைத்த வட்டி = 28938 - 25000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ கிடைத்த வட்டி = 3938

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ரூ.25,000-க்கு முறையே முதல், இரண்டாம் மற்றும் மூன்றாம் ஆண்டுகளில் 4%, 5% மற்றும் 6% வட்டி விகிதத்தில் கூட்டு வட்டி அடிப்படையில் கிடைக்கும் வட்டி ரூ.3938 ஆகும்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The correct answer is October 2014Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  •  The Air Quality Index (AQI) is a crucial initiative launched by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change in India as part of its broader environmental efforts, including the Clean India Mission (Swachh Bharat Abhiyan).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Clean India Mission: Launched on October 2, 2014, the Clean India Mission aimed to improve sanitation and cleanliness across India, addressing issues related to solid waste management, open defecation, and pollution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It is one of the flagship programs of the Government of India, focusing on both urban and rural areas.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The AQI was introduced in September 2015.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The primary goal of the AQI is to provide the public with an understandable way to gauge air quality levels in their environment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It translates complex air quality data into a format that is easy to interpret, helping people to understand the potential health effects associated with different levels of air pollution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The AQI is based on the concentration levels of specific air pollutants, including:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. Particulate Matter (PM10 and PM2.5): These are tiny particles suspended in the air that can penetrate the respiratory system and cause health problems.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2): A gas that contributes to respiratory issues and is a byproduct of vehicle emissions and industrial activities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. Sulfur Dioxide (SO2): Emitted from fossil fuel combustion and industrial processes, SO2 can cause respiratory problems and contribute to acid rain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. Carbon Monoxide (CO): A colorless, odourless gas that can be harmful when inhaled in large amounts, primarily from vehicle emissions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    5. \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  5. Ozone (O3): Ground-level ozone is a harmful air pollutant formed by the reaction of sunlight with pollutants from vehicles, power plants, and other sources.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    6. \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  सही उत्तर अक्टूबर 2014 है। Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
